name: US-48-750W
title: Switch 48 (750W)
summary: Gen1 48-port 1GbE L2 PoE+/24V-passive switch with 2x SFP + 2x SFP+, 750 W; discontinued.

extra.desc_note: desc says ports support PoE+ and 24V passive PoE
extra.thin_data: no performance/dimensions-to-hardware detail, no power draw

gotchas: Legacy US-series (Gen1) switch, not in store — replacement is the USW-Pro-48-POE / Pro Max 48 PoE.
L2 only and 1GbE-only; no PoE++ for 60 W devices.
24V passive PoE output is a footgun if misconfigured on 802.3af devices — only useful for old AC-gen gear.
Older Gen1 hardware may lag on new UniFi Network features.
best_for: reusing existing gear for 24V-passive legacy APs
